name: Maudit du Vide
description: Éveillé des profondeurs de la croûte planétaire, Maudit du Vide incarne la colère tellurique, manie l'obsidienne brute, pouvoir épique des anciens dieux, déplacement lourd et tellurique, fureur des dieux anciens. Son pas massive fait trembler le sol, annonçant l'éveil des anciens dieux de la terre.

subject.archetype: Dimensional Titan Avatar - Primordial Terror of the Chthonian Void, colossal humanoid form merged with fractured reality and living darkness

loadout.armor_outfit: Tectonic obsidian plates fused with void essence, crystalline carapace with impossible angles, magma-filled fissures running through mineral exoskeleton, living shadow tendrils integrated into shoulder structure, reality shards embedded in forearms
loadout.arsenal: Massive void-touched pickaxe forged from crystallized dimensional energy and volcanic rock, living shadow tendrils as natural secondary weapons, hands that phase between solid obsidian and ethereal darkness, eruptions of dimensional tears from body

attitude.behavior: Mid-combat charge with weapon raised overhead, one massive clawed foot planted in cracked earth as ground splits beneath, shadow tendrils erupting from back while body lunges forward with explosive force, void energy crackling around weapon edge
attitude.emotion: Abyssal hunger and primordial rage burning behind multiple molten eyes, presence radiating supernatural dread that causes reality to shudder, expression of cosmic malevolence mixed with predatory focus on target
